_note: Scene 6, the board: a circuit board drawn on the floor of the drawing, in millimetres on the floor (x to the right, z toward the camera), one layout per screen shape. scripts/board.mjs projects it through the drawing's own camera into picture pixels and writes src/generated/board.json; run it by hand (npm run board) after a change here. things: where the drawing puts the stand [x, z, turn, width, depth], the race piece [x, z, radius] and the coach phone [x, z, turn, width, length]. chip [x, z, half side]. empty [x, z, radius]: the place for the next one. routes: the live traces from the chip, in order of the film (each ends where it meets its pad). buses: [centre line, count] groups of parallel traces 6 mm apart. vias [start, step, count]. parts [x, z, 0 along x or 1 along z]. pool: the pool of light of the last pass [cx, cy, rx, ry] in picture pixels. keep: picture pixel boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] where the board never draws (the giant words). label: the StudioOS label's leader: from the chip corner [x sign, z sign], [dx, dy, run] in picture pixels (a negative run puts the word to the left; side, when given, says how the word stands off the leader's end instead: d hangs below it with its left edge on it), and NEXT below or above the empty place. ventures: which venture of content/site.json each thing is. names: the three name tags (the words come from content/site.json ventures[].name), each [x, y, side] in picture pixels, side as in build/board.ts LABEL_SHIFT (r right of the point, l left, b below and centred). screen: the coach phone's lit screen in the picture, its four corners (top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left of the screen picture) in picture pixels (the drawing's own notes). alive (build 12H, the board at work): the stand's four tiles (x of each, the height and depth of their faces' middle, mm in the stand's own frame; faces tipped 15 degrees), the side of the printed icon (mm), and the dial on the screen picture [x, y, radius] as shares of its width and height (radius: of its width). minScale: the smallest scale (screen pixels per picture pixel) the form is shown at; the net keeps clear of every label (all five) at every scale from there up, the labels growing above scale 1.
